This mahogany tree grows 40 feet to 60 feet high in our india. It takes about 12 years for a mahogany tree to fully mature and harvest. About 320 to 400 mahogany trees can be grown in an acre, which means that every 5 guntas (12.5 cents) of land can grow about 40 to 50 mahogany trees.

Uses of mahogany trees:

It is known as the king of wood because of the ever-Demanding price of the wood of this mahogany tree in the market. The important thing is that mahogany wood does not rot or rot even when soaked in water, so it is widely used in house constructions, ships, furniture, plywood and wooden sculptures in various decorative items.

The oil extracted from the leaves, flowers and seeds of the mahogany tree is used to prepare mosquito repellents and insecticides. Besides, the seeds, leaves and flowers of the mahogany tree are used in the preparation of ayurvedic medicines. Medicines prepared from these are used to treat various diseases like cancer, hypertension, asthma, cold and diabetes. Different parts of mahogany tree used in the manufacture of soaps, paints, varnishes and many other products.
